 30,381 restricted stock units ("RSUs") fully vested on September 2, 2026 and were settled in shares of the Issuer's Class A common stock. 
 Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of the Issuer's Class A common stock, subject to the Reporting Person's continued status as a service provider to the Issuer. 
 1/4 of the award vested on September 2, 2026. The remaining 91,146 RSUs vest ratably as to 1/4 of the total award of 121,527 RSUs on the 2nd of each December, March and June thereafter. 
 These RSUs do not expire; they either vest or are cancelled prior to the vesting date.
